name: CookieMan – Consent Management Platform
author: CookieMan

sections.description:
CookieMan is the complete WordPress plugin that allows you to manage your website’s cookies in full compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and all major privacy regulations.
Easy to use, lightweight, and fully customizable. Certified for Google Consent Mode v2 and integrated with the IAB TCF 2.2 framework, it helps you stay legally compliant while maintaining your site’s performance.
Take advantage of all CookieMan features to boost your site: customize every graphic element, enable multilingual support, monitor site statistics, collaborate with your team members, and much more.

Built for Privacy. Optimized for Performance.

⚖️ Full compliance with GDPR, ePrivacy, CCPA, UK-GDPR, LGPD

✅ Google Consent Mode v2 certified (maximize Google tools’ performance)

📢 Compatible with IAB TCF 2.2 (optimize ad campaigns)

🎨 Fully customizable cookie banner (colors, texts, buttons, layout)

🌍 Multilingual: frontend in 7 languages and admin panel in ITA and ENG (more coming soon)

🚫 No limits on traffic, pages, or views

📈 No data loss: collect consent without disrupting traffic analysis

🤖 Self-learning cookie detection technology

👥 Collaborative dashboard for marketing, legal, and development teams

📬 Supports lead capture and newsletter subscriptions

🧑‍💻 European hosting + expert support included

CookieMan is the ideal WordPress CMP plugin for publishers, agencies, marketers, and developers who need full control, total compliance, and real support — at a transparent price.

Features

✅ Cookie Consent & Banner Management

  • Fully customizable cookie banner (text, colors, buttons, layout)
  • Responsive
  • Asynchronous cookie activation after consent (no page reload)
  • Region-based laws compatibility
  • Consent logs with timestamp and proof of consent
  • Granular cookie categories (essential, preferences, statistics, marketing)

🌐 Multi-language & International

  • Frontend available in English, Italian, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Romanian
  • Admin panel available in English and Italian (more coming soon)
  • Auto-detects user language thanks to the activator tags

🔍 Cookie Scanning & Auto Detection

  • Auto-scan website for cookies and scripts
  • Detects popular third-party tools like Google Analytics, YouTube, Facebook, and more
  • Suggests categories and legal descriptions automatically

📊 Consent & Analytics Integration

  • Collects consent without disrupting analytics tools
  • Compatible with Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Tag Manager and more
  • Generates consent stats to help optimize your banner and increase acceptance rate

👩‍💼 Team Collaboration & Control

  • Multi-role support for marketing, dev, and legal teams
  • Integrated dashboard for all team members
  • Shared visibility on site status and consent performance

Easy Integration & Compatibility

  • Compatible with Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor, WooCommerce & more
  • Easy and fast integration with your existing WordPress forms and templates

Supported languages

CookieMan currently works with the following languages:

  • English
  • Italian
  • French
  • Spanish
  • Portuguese
  • German
  • Romanian

Learn more

If you want to explore all CookieMan’s features, visit our website for detailed information.
Remember, CookieMan is available in a single version, all-inclusive, with no traffic or page limits. No more doubts with CookieMan!

Need help?

CookieMan is always here for you: you can check out our Tutorials and FAQs on our website.
If you need technical support, feel free to contact us at help@cookieman.net.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to validate the site token and load the consent banner.

Data sent includes:

  • Token
  • Site URL
  • Language code

This information is necessary to load the correct JavaScript and display localized and customized content, in full compliance with GDPR and other privacy regulations.

Services are provided by ML Informatica S.r.l.

  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy
sections.faq:
Do you have documentation or support?

Yes, we have Tutorials and FAQs that help you answer every question about CookieMan. If you need additional support, you can write an e-mail to help@cookieman.net and one of our experts will get in touch with you.

Is CookieMan GDPR compliant?

Yes, our solution meets European and many global standards and is constantly being updated. CookieMan automatically updates when there are new regulations and laws and it gives you hints on compliance everytime you change settings on your website.

Why does my website need users’ consent to use cookies?

The EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) stipulates that websites that have users in Europe must request and obtain their explicit consent before processing their personal data.
Cookies and trackers used for statistical and advertising purposes on your website process visitors’ personal data, such as unique IDs, IP addresses, search and browser history, which is why you are required to inform users and ask for their consent in order to activate them.

Why is it important to choose a Google-certified CMP?

Adopting a CMP that conforms to Google’s Consent Mode framework is a necessity in order to make the best use of Google’s tools. Without this, it would be impossible to manage the collection of consents with all that follows, also from a regulatory point of view.
Choosing a Google-certified CMP is a guarantee for developers and site owners. Choosing a Google-certified CMP means choosing a solution that Google has vetted and verified as working.
CookieMan is certified by Google for Consent Mode v. 2. You can verify it by clicking on this link.

If I need help configuring CookieMan, who can I ask for help?

CookieMan offers some complementary services to help you configure or integrate it properly into your site. The costs of the services are charged only at the first license activation (one-time).
See the Pricing page to view details of complementary services.

How long does it take to configure the WordPress plugin?

You’ll be amazed! The installation process is super fast. In just a few seconds, CookieMan will be integrated into your site and ready to customize
